job.job_description:
We are looking for a skilled Backend Developer with 3 to 8 years of experience in Python, FastAPI/Django, and PostgreSQL to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in backend development and be able to work on FastAPI projects.



Roles and Responsibility




Design, develop, and test backend applications using Python and FastAPI.


Collaborate with the frontend team to integrate backend services with web applications.


Develop and maintain databases using PostgreSQL.


Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to backend development.


Participate in code reviews and ensure high-quality code standards.


Work closely with the team to identify and prioritize project requirements.




Job Requirements




Minimum 3 years of experience in backend development using Python and FastAPI/Django.


Strong knowledge of database concepts and experience with PostgreSQL.


Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail.


Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.


Strong communication and interpersonal skills.


Familiarity with agile development methodologies and version control systems.




About Company



Aurous consultancy sdn bhd is a leading company in the industry, providing innovative solutions to clients. We are committed to delivering high-quality services and building long-term relationships with our clients.
